notes.title: next update and news
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,

some news:
- I have removed from Steam most DLC with no content for those who wished to support me:
Emperor Tier 4.99$
King Tier 3.99$
Liege Tier 2.99$
Knight Tier 1.99$
I have kept the Squire tier 0.99$ (it is more symbolic than anything now).
I think it was a mistake to ask people for money for a free game.
I am grateful and thank all people who bought the DLC (some even bought all the tier(!)) and the game when it wasn't free, it means a lot for me. I got a real job so I won't try to make more money with Clarent Saga Tactics. But I would be happy if you give a try to the other games of Clarent Saga (Prologue and Chronicles)! 

With SRPG Studio 10th anniversary, there are more sprites! I will update the game one last time with these, and also update SRPG Studio. Maybe I will add more plugins and quality of life feature if I can implement them. I also want to rewrite and improve the original script as I think my writing wasn't really good, but maybe I'll leave it as it is. I will at least give it a try!

As I have a job, I think it's a really good time to stop making games after this last update.
10 years of SRPG Studio, how time flies! (I think I started Clarent Saga Tactics back in 2016, when it was still named Crimson Sword Saga)

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.[/p]

notes.title: v1.02 released and some comments
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

here is a minor update and some comments. The changes:

- Damage preview plugin from MarkyJoe added,
The battle forecast will preview how much damage each unit may take.
- changed old magic effects to new ones from the magic effects DLC,
- Changed some icon tomes (all are differents now).

Comments: I am fully satisfied with my game (in every aspect). Some people may find some "faults" and "shortcomings" in my game. But I think I have achieved the "purest" strategy game I can deliver. For example the minimal story and script is a deliberate choice (because I acknowledge I am not a good writer and storyteller) to keep it straightforward. Every game design choice I have made is to suit my own taste in gaming (and I have played nearly a thousand games) but I have still tried my best to make it accessible to the largest number of people. Of course, I could add more complexity in my game (enemies reinforcement, fog of war, weather, weapon experience level, reaver weapons, breakable weapons, more skills, more weapon type, stealing, etc.) but either I don't like these features or I simply don't find these fun. I think the result is a fun game that people can enjoy, but as an avid gamer I also acknowledge that it will never reach the height of a masterpiece.

Thank you for your support!
David Nguyen.

notes.title: v1.00 released and other news - the end?
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I am happy to say the final version v1.00 is released. Since the last update, there are minor corrections so this isn't really a big new. The other news are more interesting:

- I officially retire from gamemaking. I will still work on Clarent Saga if I ever feel the need and still be active on this forum. I may even stream me playing my game on Twitch someday!
- The game is and will remain free but I will add DLC with no content if you want to support me financially . Even without paying, I would be already happy if you give this game a try.
- The game script in PDF format will be released as a free DLC.
- Finally the data on the game guide has been updated with the new version.

It was a very long journey and I am a little sad to see the end of this project. I don't plan on making more game, still I sincerely hope that people will enjoy and like this game.

Thank you for your support,
David N.

notes.title: Final version is on the way!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I am glad to say the final version 1.00 is near completion! I need to recheck and retest everything before release! The truth is I have reached the limit of what I can do to improve the game. By no mean it is a perfect game but I find it quite enjoyable and fun. I also want to release some paid DLC :
- game script + exclusive short stories of characters for 2$
- A fully detailed game guide for 4$ (detailing everything about the gameplay) for 4$
- A pdf detailing all the process of making the game, discussing the prototype, ideas and the software used for 4$

I will propose a bundle at 50% promotion so you can grab everything for 5$!

I plan to make a free manual and a new (and last) trailer.

So everything may come to an end. I am grateful to Sir Wolfram for his help but I no longer work with him as he has other project of his own. I wish him the best.

Thank you for your support!
David N.

notes.title: beta v28 released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

here is a regular update. Here are the changes:
- all tutorial screenshots updated.
- changed Challenge mode : renamed Very Hard instead. This difficulty has been changed from «unfair» to «fair»: it relies a lot less on RNG and luck, enemies group move when a certain number of turns has passed. Note that it is not that hard anyway, this is a deliberate choice because I don’t want a frustrating experience but a fun one. Still far from a cakewalk and a less tedious difficulty than it once was overall. 
- Add remove level cap in cheats option : characters in part 1 and 2 has their maximum level cap raised to 21 (instead of 7 in part 1 and 14 in part 2) when activating this cheat.   
- LV Max in cheats option change: characters now don’t automatically promote when activating this cheat. 
- Ch1 change: the tile behind the throne is now traversable. This greatly change the strategy on very hard mode.
- Ch2 change: Swaped north traversable tile between the Ballistician and the bow knight (like I intended to)
- Ch11 change : archer allies have Red Bow instead of a Double Bow.
(Mt 10 and 2 consecutives attack when initiating battle) 
- Sarah start as a priest of Light (better stats cap). Sage class bonus stats corrected.

I have playtested thoroughly on the hardest difficulty. I am always seeking way to improve my game. 

Thank you for your support,
David N.

Some ideas for the next update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

here are some ideas for a future update.
1) add arena fights at the beginning of each map instead of some bonus exp. I don't know if I can implement it properly though.
2) More choice for the generation part (see below).

[spoiler]In part 1 Siegfried could choose his bride between Abigail, Nanna, and Brynhildr.
That will reflect Awan stat, growth rate and ability. Depending on her mother Awan can wield axe, spear or bow as a sub weapon and get one legendary weapon (Mjolnir, Trishula or Artemis Bow). 

In part 2 Abel could choose his bride between Ami, Athena, and Anne.
That will reflect Cain stat, growth rate and ability. Basically if Cain's mother is:
-Ami, Cain get a drain sword and medium sword as starting weapons
-Athena, Cain get a wind sword and double sword as a starting weapons
-Anne, Cain only starts with a medium sword but he can use all wands
(such as Distant heal and Full heal)

To realize this, I need to change Awan and Cain hair and eyes color and rewrite some dialog to match this!
[/spoiler]

By the way, the script/scenario rewriting may take a while, but I am not in a hurry. A minimal script has it charm too...

Thank you for your support!
David N.

ps: too many awesome games are coming this month! So my game will be a low priority...
